title: Sign of a coordinate sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $x=(x_0,\\ldots,x_{n-1})\\in\\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Define $\\sigma(b)=(-1)^b\\in\\{\\pm1\\}$ for $b\\in\\mathbb{F}_2$. Then $\\sigma\\left(\\sum_{i\\in S}x_i\\right)=\\prod_{i\\in S}\\sigma(x_i)$, where the sum is taken in $\\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
